decisions.reason: As an organic line extension tightly aligned with the firm’s stated expansion path and existing salami capabilities, it is likely to stay unless early sales clearly fall below aspirations.

This product fits the organic growth direction and snack convenience trend, and with industry growth and some hiring-related slack the firm would usually give such a close-to-core launch more time before dropping it.

Although still close to the core salami business, the premium sharing-snack concept is slightly less central than the organic lines, so it faces a somewhat higher but still modest chance of being withdrawn if performance disappoints.
